name: Gradient Estimation via Weighted Least Squares Regression
definition: A method to estimate the gradient of a scalar field by fitting a local polynomial function to data points in a neighborhood using weighted least squares, then differentiating that function.
summary: Gradient Estimation via Weighted Least Squares Regression estimates scalar field gradients by fitting local polynomials to spatial neighbors, distinguishing itself as a meshless method that handles irregular grids and low-quality meshes better than connectivity-dependent approaches.
